props.headline: Help from people who use these tools every day
props.body: Whether you are automating Microsoft Office formats with Aspose, building paperless workflows with ActivePDF, PDFlib or Investintech, or designing interfaces with DevExpress, our team knows the components you work with.

props.heading: We are here to help
props.intro: We master every component in our range, so first-line support comes from specialists who know the products.

items.title: Installs, updates and service packs
items.text: If you need help installing a new version or service pack, or something is not working, our support team can guide you through it.

items.title: "How do I...?" questions
items.text: Our team are power users who work with these tools daily. They can point you in the right direction with practical tips and advice.

items.title: Feature requests
items.text: If your work needs a feature or change in a component, tell us. We pass suggestions to the product makers and follow them up.

props.heading: Common questions about Greatstone and our support

items.q: What does Greatstone provide?
items.a: Greatstone supplies developer components for web, desktop and mobile development, with free advice before you buy and support after you buy.

items.q: How do I ask for a quote?
items.a: Use the contact page and tell us about your project. Our team will review it and come back to you to discuss what you need.

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: Our team works across a broad range of technologies, including .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript, React, Angular, Node.js and PHP.

items.q: How can I reach the support team?
items.a: By email, by phone or through the contact page. Tell us which product and version you are using and what you are trying to do.

items.q: Can you help with onboarding and implementation?
items.a: Yes. We can guide you through onboarding and implementation and share good practice for integrating a component into your project.

items.q: Is support only for customers who have bought?
items.a: No. We offer free advice before you buy, and our support continues after your purchase.

items.q: Can you help with customisations or extra features?
items.a: Yes. Talk to us about what your project needs and we will discuss the options with you and, where needed, with the product maker.

props.heading: Developer components: common questions

items.q: What kinds of developer components do you offer?
items.a: Libraries for document processing, file format automation and data handling, APIs for integrating with other services, and UI frameworks for building responsive interfaces.

items.q: How do I integrate a component into my project?
items.a: Each component comes with documentation and code samples from its maker. If you get stuck, our team can help you through the integration.

items.q: Which programming languages are supported?
items.a: It depends on the component. Many support .NET and Java, and others support C++, JavaScript, Python and more. Each product page lists its platforms.

items.q: Can I try a component before I buy?
items.a: Most components have a free trial, so you can test them on your own work first.

items.q: Are the components open source?
items.a: No. They are commercial products, licensed by their makers. Licence options differ by product; ask us and we will explain them.

items.q: Do they work with my development tools?
items.a: Most components work with common tools and platforms, such as Visual Studio and the major cloud platforms. Check the product page or ask us about your set-up.

props.heading: Free trials: common questions

items.q: How long does a free trial last?
items.a: It depends on the component; most trials last between 14 and 30 days. The product page or our team can tell you the trial length for a particular product.

items.q: Do I need to give payment details?
items.a: No. You only give payment details if you decide to buy after the trial.

items.q: Can I get help during the trial?
items.a: Yes. Our team can help with questions or problems while you evaluate the component.

items.q: How do I start a trial?
items.a: Find the product, then ask us for a trial through the product page or the contact page. We will send you what you need to get started.

items.q: Can I have more time?
items.a: If you need longer to evaluate, contact us and we will do our best to arrange an extension with the maker.

items.q: Can I try more than one component?
items.a: Yes. Each trial is separate, so you can compare different tools for your project.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: You can buy a licence to keep using the component. If you do not buy, the trial stops working as the maker's terms describe.
